seoTitle: Datixxia™ for chambers of commerce — Partnership benefits
seoDescription: Nine ways Datixxia™ works for chambers of commerce: economic forecasting, member services and a new revenue stream by postcode.

hero.label: Partners — Chambers of commerce
hero.title: How chambers benefit from partnering
hero.lead: Lead your region into the future with Datixxia™. More than just data, Datixxia™ provides foresight — helping chambers predict, plan, and prosper. Join the global network transforming raw information into measurable impact and sustainable growth.

ways.label: What your chamber gains
ways.lead: Three pillars carry the partnership — intelligence, members, revenue. The rest come built in.

pillars.title: Economic intelligence & forecasting
pillars.text: Sector-by-sector forecasts of economic activity up to four years in advance. Identify emerging or declining sectors before official statistics do — and advise members on when and where to invest, diversify or consolidate.

pillars.title: Support for member companies
pillars.text: Future tenders relevant to each member’s industry, demand forecasts for planning — and premium services like “Datixxia™ Insights for Members”.

pillars.title: Financial stability & services
pillars.text: Act as an authorized Datixxia™ reseller by postcode or region. New data services and a membership incentive unavailable elsewhere.

ways.moreTitle: And six more, built into the partnership:

more.title: Business development & investment
more.text: Future procurement demand by sector and geography; data-driven dossiers for investors.

more.title: Policy & advocacy
more.text: Quantitative evidence for governments; anticipate slowdowns and inflationary pressures.

more.title: Education & research
more.text: A teaching and research platform; datasets for forecasting models and policy design.

more.title: International cooperation
more.text: Cross-border trade maps; chamber-to-chamber trade missions and joint ventures.

more.title: Crisis monitoring & resilience
more.text: Detect fiscal stress in spending patterns; real-time response plans for regions.

more.title: Greater impact
more.text: A forward-looking, data-driven institution delivering premium intelligence.

outcomes.label: Key measurable outcomes
outcomes.note: Based on pilot modelling and scaling simulations
outcomes.text: Higher member engagement, new data-service revenues, and demonstrable economic impact make Datixxia™ both a strategic growth tool and a sustainable revenue engine for chambers worldwide.

revenue.label: New markets, new revenue
revenue.title: Your postcode. Your revenue.
revenue.text: Gain access to 14.7 million corporate prospects — the companies in the Contract Award Notices for 2025 — classified by postcode. Receive 50% of every monthly subscription fee from users within your postcode area.

survey.label: Market survey
survey.text:
If you approve the Datixxia™ project, please fill in the form below (deadline: 31 December 2025). Please invite all the interpreters, translators, language service companies and associations you know to do likewise.
The survey will allow us to find the partners needed to finance the development of the Datixxia™ application. The results will be sent to you on 2 January 2026.
If you have offices in several locations, please fill the form for each one of them.
